kind_why: A combat surf map: built to fight on rather than to time (see notes). 'arena' keeps it out of g2gfast's rotation, vote and nominations -- it stays installed, loadable with `map`, and listed on M as combat -- and marks it for game-arena's deathmatch.
author: SintaxError
notes: Credit only, and deliberately no zones: a combat surf map with no finish (see maps/zones/README.md). Team spawns split by team filters, 27 func_buttons and 10 env_entity_makers for weapons, 64 placed rifles, and 57 trigger_teleports of which nearly all aim at jaildest1..4, jailtop1..3 or a team spawn -- jails and a loop, not a route. gb-maps-1. Not published.
